lead_fa: Havoc یک اسپک DPS دو-دستهٔ چابک است که به‌جای کول‌داون‌های بلند، روی کول‌داون‌های کوتاه و غلتان بازی می‌کند و تقریباً همیشه دکمه‌ای برای فشردن دارد. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Aldrachi Reaver]] که در ریید و تک‌هدف جلوتر است و [[Fel-Scarred]] که در Mythic+ بهترین انتخاب است.

strengths: Tanky with powerful self-sustain healing; great passive magic damage reduction
Consistent AoE damage and excellent solo capabilities
Brings Chaos Brand, a debuff that increases enemy magic damage taken (unique to Demon Hunters)
weaknesses: Generates high threat in AoE despite Scars of Suffering
Exergy and similar talents can put you in precarious situations
Loses significant DPS swapping between Single Target and AoE builds

season2_changes: Dash of Chaos removed and replaced by Never Say Die
Serrated Glaive reworked from a 15s debuff on the enemy to a 12s buff on you
Trail of Ruin changed to flat instant damage instead of a DoT
Burning Hatred nerfed from 40 fury over 10s to 30 fury over 10s; Blind Fury nerfed from 30 fury per second to 20
Demon Blades buffed from 8-15 fury to 10-16
Inertia nerfed significantly from 18% to 12% damage for 5s

hero.recommendation: Fel-Scarred beats Aldrachi Reaver in most Mythic+ scenarios; in Raid and Single Target encounters Aldrachi Reaver is ahead.
hero.aldrachi_reaver: Focuses on Reaver's Glaive, which replaces Throw Glaive every time you consume 6 Shattered Souls; rotation ordering of Blade Dance and Chaos Strike changes around Reaver's Mark and Fury of the Aldrachi. Funnel through Wounded Quarry. Defensives: Army Unto Oneself (active DR) or Incorruptible Spirit (self-sustain).
hero.fel_scarred: Empowers Metamorphosis for high AoE damage; with Violent Transformation there is a small change to cast Immolation Aura on cooldown before Metamorphosis. Demonsurge scales with Mastery again. Defensives: Set Fire to the Pain (damage stagger) or Improved Soul Rending (leech).

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Havoc Demon Hunter Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/demon-hunter/havoc/talent-builds-pve-dps), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Avoid Fury Waste: Fury is spent on Chaos Strike for single target while keeping enough for Blade Dance on cooldown; pool Fury before Eye Beam comes off cooldown for the burst window.
Keep abilities on cooldown: a large portion of Havoc's damage comes from keeping Blade Dance, Vengeful Retreat, Eye Beam and Essence Break on near-constant cooldown, spending Fury during downtime.

st_aldrachi: The Hunt if you do not currently have Reaver's Glaive
Vengeful Retreat within 1 GCD before Eye Beam
Annihilation if Rending Strike is up and Glaive Flurry has already been spent
Fel Rush when no other abilities are available
rotation.aldrachi_notes: Throw Glaive is NOT cast because Screaming Brutality uses the charges for free. Reaver's Glaive replaces Throw Glaive every time you generate and pick up 6 souls; with Thrill of the Fight changes there are no rotational changes in single target (100% uptime). Fury overcap is NOT an issue while following the priority; getting cooldowns back up matters more. With Exergy, Vengeful Retreat can be held a few seconds to line up Initiative with Eye Beam or Fury of the Aldrachi. On add spawns, hold Reaver's Glaive to empower Blade Dance and funnel through Wounded Quarry; maintain Reaver's Mark on the primary target (6% per stack, single-target only).
aoe_aldrachi: The Hunt if you do not currently have Reaver's Glaive
Vengeful Retreat within 1 GCD before Eye Beam
Annihilation/Chaos Strike if Rending Strike is up (MUST spend Rending Strike before Blade Dance)
rotation.aoe_aldrachi_note: In AoE (2+ targets) always spend Reaver's Glaive empowerments on Chaos Strike first and Blade Dance second: 12 Fury of the Aldrachi slashes plus priority-target damage through Wounded Quarry.
st_felscarred: Spend all charges of Immolation Aura when Metamorphosis is up, before it is pressed
Metamorphosis once you have spent all reset abilities
The Hunt when Eye Beam cooldown is less than 10 seconds
Vengeful Retreat within 1 GCD before Eye Beam
Immolation Aura if capped on charges
Death Sweep if Demonsurge is available
Immolation Aura if at 100 Fury or less
Felblade if at 100 Fury or less
Throw Glaive or Fel Rush when no other abilities are available
rotation.felscarred_notes: Primary goal: cast Eye Beam on cooldown to maximize Demonsurge stacks. Unspent Demonsurge empowerments are lost if re-triggered by Metamorphosis or Eye Beam; spend them before pressing buttons that generate more.
aoe_felscarred: Same as single target until the filler: Immolation Aura becomes a substantial amount of DPS
With Flamebound the range is 10 yards; stay close to mobs as Immolation Aura ends so Ragefire lands
NEVER waste Immolation Aura by sitting on 2 charges or casting Metamorphosis before spending charges
opener_aldrachi: Potion of Recklessness and any on-use trinkets (e.g. Voracious Heart of Ula'tek)
rotation.opener_note: If you already have a Reaver's Glaive from a previous pull (Mythic+/Delves), use Reaver's Glaive before The Hunt. Single target and AoE openers are nearly identical.
rotation.meta_cooldowns: With Chaotic Transformation, Metamorphosis resets Eye Beam and Death Sweep cooldowns, so a large portion of burst happens right after pressing it.

gear.gearing_rules: Havoc highly prioritizes Critical Strike; aim for Crit pieces or special-effect BiS like Aman'muso, Warlord's Vengeance. Damage-proc trinkets beat big stat amps, especially as Aldrachi Reaver is not burst based. Agility/ilvl upgrades still win. Sim with Raidbots.

tier_set.name: Abyssal Doomhound's Pursuit
tier_set.pc2: Blade Dance, Chaos Strike, and Essence Break have 12% increased damage.
tier_set.pc4: Essence Break now applies and benefits from the effects of Cycle of Hatred, has 35% increased initial strike damage, and has 2.0 sec increased duration.
tier_set.note: Requires talenting and playing Essence Break at all times; its lowered cooldown mostly desyncs it from the rest of the kit so it is pressed on cooldown.

crafted: Silvermoon Agent's Deflectors with Arcanoweave Lining

notes: Critical Strike > Mastery > Haste >> Versatility for both Aldrachi Reaver and Fel-Scarred.
Do not neglect Agility: a substantial item level increase is generally better than optimized stats.
Sim your character with Raidbots for exact values.

mplus.hero_note: Fel-Scarred beats Aldrachi Reaver in most Mythic+ scenarios.
tips: Night Elf Shadowmeld drops aggro or cancels casts, strong in M+; Void Elf Spatial Rift is mostly unnecessary for Havoc's mobility; Arcane Torrent is the weakest option since Consume Magic exists.
Damage-proc trinkets beat on-use stat amps in Havoc's rolling cooldown playstyle.
If Reaver's Glaive persists from a previous pull, use it before The Hunt on the next pull.
